column1: Andy Pages leads the slate with a strong combination of recent form and a favorable matchup, showing steady contact rates and a clear platoon edge against Kyle Freeland in a hitter-friendly park. Shohei Ohtani also profiles well near the top of the order, benefiting from the same soft opposing pitcher and elevated park factor. Xavier Edwards offers reliability with consistent hit rates, but faces a tougher arm in Aaron Nola. Freddie Freeman and Jake McCarthy round out the group with less recent consistency.
